title: Bridging condensins mediate compaction of mitotic chromosomes.
authors: Forte, Giada; Boteva, Lora; Conforto, Filippo; Gilbert, Nick; Cook, Peter R; Marenduzzo, Davide
one_liner_zh: 该文用布朗动力学模拟研究凝缩蛋白介导的染色体压缩，虽涉及蛋白质-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或分子对接方法，仅物理模拟染色体结构。
abstract: Eukaryotic chromosomes compact during mitosis into elongated cylinders-and not the spherical globules expected of self-attracting long flexible polymers. This process is mainly driven by condensin-like proteins. Here, we present Brownian-dynamic simulations involving two types of such proteins with different activities. One, which we refer to as looping condensins, anchors long-lived chromatin loops to create bottlebrush structures. The second, referred to as bridging condensins, forms multivalent bridges between distant parts of these loops. We show that binding of bridging condensins leads to the formation of shorter and stiffer mitotic-like cylinders without requiring any additional energy input. These cylinders have several features matching experimental observations. For instance, the axial condensin backbone breaks up into clusters as found by microscopy, and cylinder elasticity qualitatively matches that seen in chromosome pulling experiments. Additionally, simulating global condensin depletion or local faulty condensin loading gives phenotypes seen experimentally and points to a mechanistic basis for the structure of common fragile sites in mitotic chromosomes.
abstract_zh: 真核染色体在有丝分裂过程中压缩成细长的圆柱体，而非自吸引长柔性聚合物所预期的球形团块。这一过程主要由凝缩蛋白样蛋白驱动。在此，我们提出了涉及两种具有不同活性的此类蛋白的布朗动力学模拟。其中一种，我们称之为环状凝缩蛋白（looping condensins），锚定长寿命染色质环以形成瓶刷结构。第二种，称为桥接凝缩蛋白（bridging condensins），在这些环的远距离部分之间形成多价桥接。我们表明，桥接凝缩蛋白的结合导致形成更短且更刚性的有丝分裂样圆柱体，无需任何额外能量输入。这些圆柱体具有与实验观察相匹配的多个特征。例如，轴向凝缩蛋白骨架如显微镜所发现的那样断裂成簇，且圆柱体弹性在定性上与染色体拉伸实验中观察到的结果一致。此外，模拟全局凝缩蛋白耗竭或局部异常凝缩蛋白加载可产生实验观察到的表型，并指向有丝分裂染色体中常见脆性位点结构的机制基础。
